texts.preamble: Sheikh Babu vs State Of Odisha & Ors. ..... Opposite ... on 11 April, 2025 Author: S. K. Panigrahi Bench: S. K. Panigrahi In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack W.P.(C) No.9832 of 2025 Sheikh Babu ..... Petitioner Mr. Kaibalya Panda, Advocate -versus- State of Odisha & Ors. ..... Opposite Parties Mr. Sanjay Rath, Aga Coram: The Hon'Ble Dr. Justice S. K. Panigrahi Order Order No. 11.04.2025 01. 1.
texts.facts: 2. The Petitioner, by filing this Writ Petition, has challenged the action of the Opposite Party No.2/Food Safety Officer, Puri Municipality along with other Government Officers in sealing the meat shop of the Petitioner on 07.03.2025. However, the authority has not given any instruction on the sample taken by them till date.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that because of some viral videos uploaded in the social media by some miscreants, the Opposite Party No.2/ Food Safety Officer, Puri Municipality along with other officers rushed to the spot and sealed the meat spot and issued a notice on 07.03.2025.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that because of some viral videos uploaded in the social media by some miscreants, the Opposite Party No.2/ Food Safety Officer, Puri Municipality along with other officers rushed to the spot and sealed the meat spot and issued a notice on 07.03.2025.
